content: Attio: sidebar is a collapsible control hub gating records/notifications/tasks/notes/emails/reports/automations; cmd+k for commands, / for search; data itself organized as customizable 'views' (table/list/kanban) layered over one record object rather than separate nav per feature; Spreadsheet Grid = high-density table with 1px borders + high-contrast headers; Record Sidebar = vertical overlay with integrated field editing + activity log.
